info.name: Power BI REST Dashboards Datasets API

description.content:
The Power BI REST API provides service endpoints for embedding, administration, governance, and user resources. It enables programmatic access to Power BI content including datasets, reports, dashboards, and workspaces (groups). The API uses Azure Active Directory (OAuth 2.0) for authentication and authorization.
